name: Tatoeba, Konna Koi Monogatari.
original_name: たとえば、こんな恋物語。
source:
This is a set of a short-length digital novel that the heroines' faces will be revealed in the end and a recitation audio work in approx. 1 hour 50 minutes.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE243123.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一套作品，包括一部短篇数字小说（女主角的脸将在结尾揭晓）和一部约1小时50分钟的朗读音频作品。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE243123.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
